description: Reusable teaching framework; original practice material, not an official exam question bank.

chapters.title: My studies & identity
chapters.subtitle: 身份、专业或工作与日常学习

grammar.title: be 动词：身份、状态与否定
grammar.pattern: I am / You are / It is; am not / isn't / aren't
grammar.note: am/is/are 后接身份、状态、地点；不要在 be 后再加普通动词原形。

grammar.title: 基础句型：主谓宾与主系表
grammar.pattern: S + V + O / S + V + complement
grammar.note: 先保证句子主干完整，再添加原因、时间和例子；不要用中文的“因为……所以……”直译成双连词。

grammar.title: 人称代词、宾格和所有格
grammar.pattern: I / me / my / mine; we / us / our / ours
grammar.note: I 作主语，me 作宾语；my 后要接名词，mine 单独使用。

grammar.title: 冠词 a/an/the 与零冠词
grammar.pattern: a/an + 单数可数；the + 特指；零冠词 + 泛指复数/不可数
grammar.note: 专业、学科的泛称一般不用 the；第一次提到一项具体事物常用 a/an。

grammar.title: 主谓一致与三单 -s
grammar.pattern: he/she/it + works; people work; everyone has
grammar.note: 口语高分仍要求基础准确：everyone/someone/every student 后接单数谓语；people 用复数。

grammar.title: there is / there are：存在句
grammar.pattern: There is + 单数/不可数；There are + 复数
grammar.note: 有/没有某物用 there be，比反复说“my hometown has”更自然。

grammar.title: have / has / have got：拥有与特征
grammar.pattern: have / has + object; have got / has got
grammar.note: 描述城市、房间、设备的特征；have got 较口语，但不要在同一句中机械混用。

grammar.title: this/that/these/those：指示与对比
grammar.pattern: this/these 近；that/those 远；one/ones 替代
grammar.note: 口语中用 this place / that area / these days 自然承接上下文。

grammar.title: 地点、时间介词 in/on/at 与常用搭配
grammar.pattern: in a city / on a street / at university; in 2026 / on Monday / at night
grammar.note: 介词高度依赖搭配；把整块词组读熟比记中文对应更有用。

grammar.title: 比较级与最高级
grammar.pattern: -er / more ... than; the -est / the most; as ... as
grammar.note: 避免“more better”；比较对象要可比。用 a bit / much / far 增加自然度。

grammar.title: 一般现在时：习惯与事实
grammar.pattern: I usually do; he often does; don't / doesn't; Do you...?
grammar.note: 讲规律性行为、事实和喜好；不是“现在正在做”的意思。

grammar.title: 一般现在时疑问句与否定句
grammar.pattern: Do/Does + S + V?; S + don't/doesn't + V
grammar.note: 一定记住 does 后动词回原形，不能说 Does he studies。

grammar.title: 频率副词与时间表达
grammar.pattern: always / usually / often / sometimes / hardly ever / never
grammar.note: 频率副词常放在实义动词前、be 后；never 本身否定，不能再加 don't。

grammar.title: 现在进行时：正在发生与暂时安排
grammar.pattern: am/is/are + V-ing; not ...; Are you ...?
grammar.note: 用于说话时、这段时间的临时行为；区别于一般现在时的长期习惯。

grammar.title: 状态动词与现在简单/进行时对照
grammar.pattern: know / believe / prefer / own (通常不用进行时)
grammar.note: I know 而非 I'm knowing；但 I'm thinking about... 是“正在考虑”，语义不同。

grammar.title: 可数、不可数与复数
grammar.pattern: an apple / two apples; advice, information, equipment 不可数
grammar.note: 口语常错：an advice / informations / equipments 均不规范。

grammar.title: some/any/no 与复合不定代词
grammar.pattern: some / any; someone / anyone / nobody
grammar.note: 疑问句请求或主动提供可以用 some：Would you like some...?

grammar.title: much/many/a lot of/few/little
grammar.pattern: many + 可数复数; much + 不可数; a few/a little 正向
grammar.note: few/little 常含“太少”语气，a few/a little 则表示“有一些”。

grammar.title: 动名词与不定式：喜欢、计划、避免
grammar.pattern: enjoy/avoid + V-ing; want/plan/decide + to V
grammar.note: 先按动词记搭配，而不是所有动词都强行套 to do 或 doing。

grammar.title: 礼貌请求与提议
grammar.pattern: Could you...? / Would you mind V-ing...? / Shall we...?
grammar.note: Could 比 Can 往往更委婉；Would you mind 后接 V-ing。

grammar.title: 现在完成时：经历、影响与结果
grammar.pattern: have/has + past participle; haven't; Have you...?
grammar.note: 过去发生但与现在相关，或不说具体过去时间；have gone / have been 区别。

grammar.title: ever/never：是否有过某种经历
grammar.pattern: Have you ever V3? / I've never V3.
grammar.note: never 已带否定；回答“从未”不说 I haven't never。

grammar.title: already/yet/just 与位置
grammar.pattern: have already V3 / haven't V3 yet / have just V3
grammar.note: yet 常在疑问和否定句末，already 多在助动词后，just 表示刚刚。

grammar.title: for/since：从过去持续到现在
grammar.pattern: have V3 for + 时长 / since + 起点
grammar.note: for three years / since 2023；持续状态可说 have lived，不能随意用 have started for。

grammar.title: 现在完成进行时：持续投入与未完事项
grammar.pattern: have/has been + V-ing; haven't been; Have you been...?
grammar.note: 强调持续进行的过程；完成时强调结果，完成进行时强调过程和时长。

grammar.title: 一般过去时：过去发生的事件
grammar.pattern: V-ed / irregular V2; was / were
grammar.note: 讲过去具体经历，时间已结束；规则和不规则动词都要能脱口而出。

grammar.title: 过去否定句和疑问句 did
grammar.pattern: didn't + V; Did + S + V?
grammar.note: did 出现后实义动词必须回原形：didn't went 错，应是 didn't go。

grammar.title: 过去进行时：过去某时正在做
grammar.pattern: was/were + V-ing; wasn't; Were you...?
grammar.note: 给故事铺背景，或描述过去特定时刻正在进行的动作。

grammar.title: 一般过去 vs 过去进行：背景与打断
grammar.pattern: was V-ing when V2; while was V-ing, ...
grammar.note: when 常引出短动作，while 常强调同时进行的背景；重点是事件关系。

grammar.title: used to / would：过去的习惯
grammar.pattern: used to V; didn't use to V; Did you use to V?
grammar.note: used to 可表旧状态和习惯；would 主要叙述反复过去动作，不直接表旧状态。

grammar.title: will：即时决定、预测与承诺
grammar.pattern: will / won't + V; Will you...?
grammar.note: will 不等于所有将来；即兴决策、承诺、判断可优先用它。

grammar.title: be going to：事先打算与有迹象的预测
grammar.pattern: am/is/are going to + V
grammar.note: 事先有计划/明确证据；和 will 的区别是语境，不必机械绝对化。

grammar.title: 现在进行时表示已安排的将来
grammar.pattern: am meeting / are leaving + future time
grammar.note: 多用于已经有安排的计划；与 going to 相比，安排感更强。

grammar.title: 一般现在时表示固定时刻表
grammar.pattern: The train leaves at... / The shop opens at...
grammar.note: 公开时刻表、长期固定的时间安排，即使未来也常用一般现在时。

grammar.title: 第一条件句与将来时间从句
grammar.pattern: If + present, will + V; when/as soon as + present, future
grammar.note: 条件/时间从句中通常不用 will：If it rains, we'll stay in。

grammar.title: -ed 与 -ing 形容词
grammar.pattern: interested / interesting; bored / boring
grammar.note: -ed 常描述感受者，-ing 常描述引发感受的事物。

grammar.title: 程度副词与语气调整
grammar.pattern: quite / rather / fairly / pretty / incredibly + adj
grammar.note: 口语里 naturally hedge：pretty good、a bit dull；avoid endless 'very very'。

grammar.title: 限定性定语从句 who/which/that
grammar.pattern: a person who... / a film that... / a tool which...
grammar.note: 用于具体说明“哪一个”；口语中宾语关系代词常可省略。

grammar.title: whose/where/when：关系词扩展
grammar.pattern: a person whose... / a place where... / a time when...
grammar.note: whose 表示所属；where/when 引出地点或时间的从句，不只是“那个地方”的重复。

grammar.title: 非限定性定语从句与补充说明
grammar.pattern: noun, which/who... , ...
grammar.note: 逗号内是附加信息；不可随便用 that；which 可概括前句整体情况。

grammar.title: can/could/be able to：能力与可能
grammar.pattern: can V / could V / have been able to V
grammar.note: can 没有标准完成式，用 have been able to；could 可表过去通常能力。

grammar.title: should/ought to 与建议语气
grammar.pattern: should / shouldn't / ought to + V
grammar.note: 建议不是命令；I suppose / probably / might want to 能更柔和。

grammar.title: must / have to / mustn't：义务和禁止
grammar.pattern: must V / have to V / mustn't V
grammar.note: mustn't = 禁止；don't have to = 不必，两者意思截然不同。

grammar.title: don't have to / needn't / be allowed to
grammar.pattern: don't have to V; needn't V; be allowed to V
grammar.note: 不必、无需与不被允许要明确区分。

grammar.title: may/might/could：不确定性与婉转推测
grammar.pattern: may/might/could + V
grammar.note: 口语 7.5+ 常需要控制确定程度，而不是每句都说 definitely。

grammar.title: 一般时态被动语态
grammar.pattern: am/is/are + V3; was/were + V3
grammar.note: 侧重行动对象；不知道/不需提执行者时常用被动。

grammar.title: 进行时、完成时被动
grammar.pattern: is being V3 / has been V3 / had been V3
grammar.note: 关注事情“正被做/已经被做”；避免把完成时和被动语序写反。

grammar.title: 情态动词被动
grammar.pattern: should/must/can/might + be + V3
grammar.note: 讨论公共建议和政策十分常用；不要写 should be do。

grammar.title: get + V3：事件性被动
grammar.pattern: get damaged / get caught / get repaired
grammar.note: get-passive 常比 be-passive 更口语，强调事情发生、意外或变化。

grammar.title: have/get something done：请人处理
grammar.pattern: have/get + object + V3
grammar.note: 表请人完成事情：I had my laptop repaired，不是“我亲自修”。

grammar.title: 过去完成时：过去的过去
grammar.pattern: had + V3; hadn't; Had you...?
grammar.note: 两个过去事件：先发生的常用 had V3；没必要每个过去动作都用过去完成。

grammar.title: 过去完成进行时：持续到过去某一点
grammar.pattern: had been + V-ing
grammar.note: 强调过去某时之前一直在进行的活动，多用于故事交代背景。

grammar.title: 将来进行时：未来特定时间正在做
grammar.pattern: will be + V-ing; won't be; Will you be...?
grammar.note: 表示在未来某时进行的活动，也用于较礼貌地询问安排。

grammar.title: 将来完成时：截至某未来时点完成
grammar.pattern: will have + V3; won't have; Will you have...?
grammar.note: by + 未来时间点；说目标结果；不建议在短回答里频繁硬塞。

grammar.title: 将来完成进行时：未来时点的持续时长
grammar.pattern: will have been + V-ing + for...
grammar.note: 较少见，掌握识别和自然使用即可；高分不需要刻意炫技。

grammar.title: 现在完成时与一般过去时的时间界限
grammar.pattern: I've visited... / I visited ... last year
grammar.note: 有具体已结束时间（last year / in 2024）优先过去时；经历与现状连接可用完成时。

grammar.title: be used to / get used to + V-ing
grammar.pattern: be used to + noun / V-ing; get used to + V-ing
grammar.note: 不是 used to V（过去常常）；be used to doing = 已习惯。

grammar.title: so ... that / such ... that：程度与结果
grammar.pattern: so + adj/adv + that; such + (a/an) + adj + noun + that
grammar.note: so 后接形容词/副词；such 后接名词性词组。

grammar.title: too ... to / ... enough to
grammar.pattern: too + adj + to V; adj + enough + to V
grammar.note: too ... to 常表过度而做不到；enough 在形容词后、名词前。

grammar.title: because / so / although / but：基础复合句
grammar.pattern: because + clause; although + clause, main clause
grammar.note: 避免 because...so... 和 although...but... 同句双连词。

chapters.title: A person who influenced me
chapters.subtitle: 影响自己的老师、同事或导师

grammar.title: 叙事时间线：at first / later / eventually
grammar.pattern: at first → after a while → eventually; by the time...
grammar.note: 不是语法时态本身，而是支撑复杂叙事的时间衔接；配合过去时使用。

grammar.title: 宾语关系代词的省略
grammar.pattern: the advice (that) she gave me / the person (who) I met
grammar.note: 关系代词充当宾语时多可省略，口语更流畅；做主语时不能随便删。

grammar.title: 强调助动词 do/did
grammar.pattern: I do believe... / I did enjoy...
grammar.note: do/did + 动词原形表达真诚强调，适度使用；不必每句都加。

grammar.title: 强调句 It was ... that/who ...
grammar.pattern: It was X that/who did Y
grammar.note: 强调人物、时间、地点或事件原因；自然强调关键转折，不要机械加长。

grammar.title: What 从句作主语/表语焦点
grammar.pattern: What I learned was... / What matters is...
grammar.note: 用 what 概括一整件事；谓语单复数按意义安排，别过量重复。

chapters.title: A difficult problem I solved
chapters.subtitle: 一次真实的挑战与解决过程

grammar.title: 第三条件句：与过去事实相反
grammar.pattern: If + had V3, would/could/might have V3
grammar.note: 讨论“当时如果……结果本可以……”，千万别写 if I would have。

grammar.title: should/could/might have done：过去评价
grammar.pattern: should have V3 / could have V3 / might have V3
grammar.note: should have 往往含后悔或批评；could have 表当时本有可能。

grammar.title: wish + 过去完成时：对过去的遗憾
grammar.pattern: I wish I had V3 / If only I had V3
grammar.note: wish + had V3 是“希望过去不同”，不能用 wish I would have 表同一意思。

grammar.title: 混合条件句：过去原因、现在结果
grammar.pattern: If + had V3, would V now
grammar.note: 过去不同→现在不同，尤其适合成长与反思。

grammar.title: 让步与转折：even though / despite
grammar.pattern: even though + clause; despite + noun/V-ing
grammar.note: 尽管有困难仍采取行动。despite 后面不要直接接完整句子。

chapters.title: A place I would recommend
chapters.subtitle: 自己熟悉并愿意推荐的地点

grammar.title: 现在分词短语作后置定语
grammar.pattern: people living nearby / a path leading to...
grammar.note: V-ing 短语紧接修饰对象，表示主动/进行；别产生悬垂修饰。

grammar.title: 过去分词短语作后置定语
grammar.pattern: a bridge built in... / houses painted white
grammar.note: V3 多表被动或完成，适合描述建筑、场所与设计。

grammar.title: 分词状语：Walking / Having ...
grammar.pattern: Walking through..., I noticed... / Having finished..., I ...
grammar.note: 逻辑主语必须与主句一致；难度较高但适合自然的故事表达。

grammar.title: with + 名词 + 补足语
grammar.pattern: with the sun setting / with its doors open / with ... done
grammar.note: 用来补充现场背景或状态，口语叙事很有效。

grammar.title: 同位语与精确名词短语
grammar.pattern: my hometown, a city in... / my colleague, a researcher...
grammar.note: 通过插入简短定义让考官理解陌生地点，不必长篇解释。

chapters.title: A trip or special day
chapters.subtitle: 一次出行、活动或特别的日子

grammar.title: 直接引语与间接引语基础
grammar.pattern: She said, '...' → She said (that) ...
grammar.note: 复述别人的话时不必硬背原句；注意人称、时间视角和时态。

grammar.title: say / tell / ask 的结构
grammar.pattern: say something; tell somebody something; ask somebody to V
grammar.note: 不能说 tell to me（常规语境应 tell me）；ask sb to do 用于请求。

grammar.title: 间接疑问句：陈述语序
grammar.pattern: Do you know where it is? / I wonder if...
grammar.note: 不能说 Do you know where is it?；间接疑问句使用陈述语序。

grammar.title: 过去将来时 would / was going to
grammar.pattern: said I would V; was going to V, but...
grammar.note: 在过去时间点谈“当时的未来”；讲计划如何改变很有用。

grammar.title: be about to / on the point of：即将发生
grammar.pattern: be about to V / be on the point of V-ing
grammar.note: 叙事中的临界一刻；通常和 when 引出突发转折。

chapters.title: A useful invention or device
chapters.subtitle: 日常设备与有用的发明

grammar.title: make / let / have 使役结构
grammar.pattern: make/let/have + sb + V
grammar.note: 主动结构后用动词原形：make me think；被动 be made to V 例外。

grammar.title: get / help / encourage + sb + to do
grammar.pattern: get/encourage sb to V; help sb (to) V
grammar.note: get sb to do = 设法让某人做；help 后 to 可省。

grammar.title: 感官动词 see/hear + V / V-ing
grammar.pattern: see sb do (全过程) / doing (进行中的片段)
grammar.note: 两种结构重点不同；感官动词被动通常接 to V。

grammar.title: stop / remember / try + V-ing vs to V
grammar.pattern: stop doing / stop to do; remember doing / remember to do
grammar.note: doing 与 to do 的意思可能完全不同：stop smoking ≠ stop to smoke。

grammar.title: 目的不定式与不定式后置修饰
grammar.pattern: to V / in order to V / something to V
grammar.note: 简洁解释“为了什么”；to do 修饰某人要做的事情也常见。

chapters.title: A project I am proud of
chapters.subtitle: 自己参与并感到自豪的项目

grammar.title: not only ... but also ...：递进并列
grammar.pattern: not only A but also B; Not only + inversion ...
grammar.note: 普通口语无需倒装；只在 Not only 置于句首时需要倒装。

grammar.title: both / either / neither：两者逻辑
grammar.pattern: both A and B; either A or B; neither A nor B
grammar.note: both 肯定两者；either 任选一个；neither 两者都不；就近一致注意。

grammar.title: 第二条件句：现在或未来的假设
grammar.pattern: If + past, would/could/might + V
grammar.note: 和真实的第一条件句区别：现在与将来的假设、不太确定的可能。

grammar.title: would rather / would prefer / prefer
grammar.pattern: would rather + V; would prefer to V; prefer V-ing to V-ing
grammar.note: would rather 后不用 to；prefer A to B 是对比长期偏好。

grammar.title: 名词性结果表达：lead to / result in / enable
grammar.pattern: lead to + noun/V-ing; result in + noun; enable sb to V
grammar.note: 用比单纯 because...so... 更精确的因果；别过度名词化。

chapters.title: A decision I had to make
chapters.subtitle: 选择、权衡与一次转折

grammar.title: unless / as long as / provided that
grammar.pattern: unless + clause; as long as + clause; provided that + clause
grammar.note: unless = if not；as long as / provided that = 条件满足就可以。

grammar.title: even if / even though：假设和事实
grammar.pattern: even if = 即使（假设）；even though = 尽管（事实）
grammar.note: 两者不能完全互换：even if it rains 是假设；even though it rained 是事实。

grammar.title: as if / as though：看起来仿佛
grammar.pattern: seem/look as if + clause; talked as if...
grammar.note: 可说事实性的 as if，也可用过去式表达非事实、主观距离。

grammar.title: otherwise / or else：替代后果
grammar.pattern: Do X; otherwise, Y will... / X, or else Y...
grammar.note: 展示决策的必要性与结果；otherwise 可承接条件，不一定要 if。

grammar.title: must/can't/might have done：过去推断
grammar.pattern: must have V3 / can't have V3 / might have V3
grammar.note: must have 是有较强证据的推断；can't have 是否定不可能。

chapters.title: A skill I learned or taught
chapters.subtitle: 自学、分享与帮助他人

grammar.title: 完成式动名词 having done
grammar.pattern: regret/remember + having V3; after having V3
grammar.note: 强调动名词动作早于主句；口语中可选普通 doing，不必强塞复杂结构。

grammar.title: 被动不定式与被动动名词
grammar.pattern: to be V3; being V3; having been V3
grammar.note: 在“需要被完成/避免被打断/被认可”等场景自然使用。

grammar.title: keep / end up / manage to / fail to
grammar.pattern: keep V-ing / end up V-ing / manage to V / fail to V
grammar.note: 讲学习过程中的坚持、结果、成败，贴近日常口语。

grammar.title: 过去义务与不必：had to / didn't have to
grammar.pattern: had to V / didn't have to V / was supposed to V
grammar.note: 昨天“必须”不是 musted；didn't have to 与 mustn't 区分。

grammar.title: 反问与回应：isn't it / don't you think...
grammar.pattern: ..., isn't it? / Don't you think that...?
grammar.note: 反问用于互动，而非考试套话；附加疑问句助动词与主句呼应。

grammar.title: 泛指与限定：most / some / not all
grammar.pattern: Most + plural; Not all...; A minority of...
grammar.note: Part 3 避免“人人都……”的绝对判断；语法准确也体现观点严谨。

grammar.title: the more..., the more...：双重比较
grammar.pattern: The + comparative ..., the + comparative ...
grammar.note: 双重比较表示相关变化，不一定是严格因果。

grammar.title: that 从句：判断、观点和证据
grammar.pattern: I believe (that)... / The fact that ... suggests...
grammar.note: that 作为内容从句引导词，口语有时可省；句子主干必须完整。

grammar.title: whether / if 名词性从句与 whether...or...
grammar.pattern: whether S + V; whether A or B
grammar.note: 正式名词性结构常用 whether；介词后通常用 whether，不用 if。

grammar.title: what / how / why 作名词性从句
grammar.pattern: What schools need is...; how people learn; why this matters
grammar.note: what 引导名词性从句并在从句内部充当成分；可作为句子的主题。

grammar.title: although / even though：真实让步
grammar.pattern: Although S + V, main; even though S + V,...
grammar.note: 一句承认好处再指出风险，讨论更平衡，不要搭配 but 双连词。

grammar.title: while / whereas：并列对照
grammar.pattern: While A..., B... / A..., whereas B...
grammar.note: while 可表时间或对比；Part3 常用对比不同群体和利弊。

grammar.title: no matter how / what / where：无论
grammar.pattern: no matter how + adj; no matter what + clause
grammar.note: 讨论普遍原则；适合口语观点结尾，切勿每句话都升格为口号。

grammar.title: whoever / whatever / whichever 自由关系从句
grammar.pattern: Whoever uses... / Whatever happens... / whichever is...
grammar.note: 代词本身在从句内起作用，口语用于泛指与选择。

grammar.title: 观点弱化与推测：tend to / seem to / be likely to
grammar.pattern: tend to V / seem to V / be likely to V
grammar.note: “并非必然”的表达能体现事实边界，也让观点更自然。

chapters.title: Climate, energy & sustainability
chapters.subtitle: 气候、能源与可持续生活

grammar.title: because / because of / due to：原因层级
grammar.pattern: because + clause; because of + noun; due to + noun
grammar.note: because of 后不要直接接完整句；因果链越清晰越好。

grammar.title: so that / in order that：表达目标
grammar.pattern: so that + S + can/could/will/would + V
grammar.note: 表目标而非结果；主句和从句要有清楚的目的关系。

grammar.title: 零条件句：普遍规律与机制
grammar.pattern: If/When + present, present
grammar.note: 不是未来预测，而是惯常结果、规律或系统行为。

grammar.title: 被动报告结构：It is believed that...
grammar.pattern: It is often argued that... / X is believed to V
grammar.note: 传递他人观点同时保持距离；“据称”不是证据，注意来源。

grammar.title: which 引导整句结果与非限定关系
grammar.pattern: main clause, which means / which makes...
grammar.note: which 指代整件事而非某个名词，便于自然解释后果。

chapters.title: Cities, transport & housing
chapters.subtitle: 城市化、公共交通与居住

grammar.title: 虚拟语气：If I were / If cities were...
grammar.pattern: If + S + were..., S would...
grammar.note: 与目前情况不符的假设；正式或考试英语常用 If I were。

grammar.title: 省略 if 的虚拟倒装：Were ... to ...
grammar.pattern: Were + S + to V, S would...
grammar.note: 高级可用，但口语中偏正式；自然聊天用 If...were to 同样好。

grammar.title: would rather + 人 + 过去式：对别人行为的期望
grammar.pattern: I'd rather the city invested...
grammar.note: 与 I'd rather do 不同；I'd rather you didn't... 用过去式表达当前偏好。

grammar.title: compared with / unlike / in comparison
grammar.pattern: compared with + noun; unlike + noun; by comparison,...
grammar.note: 对比论证最好先说比较维度，避免跨对象比较。

grammar.title: 条件结果链：If...would..., meaning that...
grammar.pattern: If X happened, Y would..., meaning that Z...
grammar.note: Part 3 重要的是多层推理，而不只是堆复杂句。

grammar.title: 介词 + which/whom 关系从句
grammar.pattern: the field in which... / people with whom...
grammar.note: 更正式的关系从句；口语可灵活说 the field I work in。

grammar.title: what = the thing(s) that：抽象主语
grammar.pattern: What employers value is...; What changes is...
grammar.note: 将讨论焦点放在观点而不是“I think...I think...”。

grammar.title: 情态动词：现在推断 must / can't / might
grammar.pattern: must be / can't be / might be + adj / V-ing
grammar.note: 讨论政策与就业不必处处确定；must 是逻辑判断，不等于“必须”。

grammar.title: in spite of / regardless of / despite
grammar.pattern: despite + noun/doing; regardless of + noun
grammar.note: Part 3 谈原则时，用 regardless of 指“无论是否”；注意介词后词形。

grammar.title: had better / be better off / might as well
grammar.pattern: had better + V / be better off V-ing / might as well + V
grammar.note: 用于权衡实际建议；had better 带较强后果意味。

grammar.title: 建议式虚拟语气：that + 动词原形
grammar.pattern: recommend that S (should) + V; insist that S + V
grammar.note: 英式英语可保留 should；考口语别刻意全用，熟练表达即可。

grammar.title: It is essential/important that...
grammar.pattern: It is essential that S (should) V / be V3
grammar.note: 描述必要性；be 原形作正式虚拟语气，不是把 is 遗漏了。

grammar.title: only when / only if 置首引起倒装
grammar.pattern: Only when + clause + auxiliary + S + V
grammar.note: 句首 only + 状语触发主句倒装；自然口语用普通语序亦可。

grammar.title: not until ... did：强调时间转折
grammar.pattern: Not until + time/clause + did + S + V
grammar.note: 倒装在主句而非 until 从句；可用较口语的 It wasn't until...that。

grammar.title: it is high time + 过去式：早该做
grammar.pattern: It's (high) time + S + past
grammar.note: 虽用过去式，表达现在“早该如此”，语气相对强。

chapters.title: Media, culture & globalisation
chapters.subtitle: 传统文化、媒体与全球化

grammar.title: however / nevertheless / on the other hand
grammar.pattern: sentence. However, sentence. / ...; nevertheless, ...
grammar.note: 连接副词与 but 语法位置不同；口语适度停顿即可。

grammar.title: neither ... nor ... 与否定副词倒装
grammar.pattern: Neither A nor B + V / Neither do I; Nor do I
grammar.note: neither...nor 两者都不；句首 Neither do I 为附和否定。

grammar.title: not so much A as B：不是A而是B
grammar.pattern: not so much A as B
grammar.note: 适合指出真正原因，带有修正和强调意味。

grammar.title: nominalisation：动词观点的名词化
grammar.pattern: improve → improvement; decide → decision; regulate → regulation
grammar.note: 名词化有助于抽象讨论，但英语口语仍要可听懂，别连续堆抽象名词。

grammar.title: 同位语 that 从句：抽象观念的内容
grammar.pattern: the idea that... / the belief that... / the claim that...
grammar.note: the idea that... 的 that 不是关系代词，而是解释“具体是什么想法”。

chapters.title: The future of society & technology
chapters.subtitle: 未来社会、科技和人生选择

grammar.title: 将来完成时表达社会变化的预测
grammar.pattern: By + future time, will have V3
grammar.note: 讨论未来时间节点的结果；具体时点要清楚，避免空泛“未来将已经……”。

grammar.title: 将来进行时表达社会常态
grammar.pattern: will be V-ing; may be V-ing
grammar.note: 与将来完成对照：描述未来某时正在发生/持续的行为，不强调完成。

grammar.title: rarely / seldom / hardly 句首倒装
grammar.pattern: Rarely do S V...; Seldom have S V3...
grammar.note: 倒装较书面；Part3 点到为止，不能为了“高级”牺牲语气自然性。

grammar.title: 复杂虚拟：现在结果与过去条件
grammar.pattern: If S had V3, S would V now; If S were..., would have V3
grammar.note: 混合条件句只有在时间关系明确时才自然，否则简单句更好。

grammar.title: 综合：让步 + 假设 + 判断 + 结果
grammar.pattern: While A..., if B..., C might..., which...
grammar.note: 7.5/8 目标是自然灵活，不是每句 40 词；复杂结构和准确简单句交替。
